reasons: Too few verified correspondences: 3 (threshold 8). Near the model's degrees of freedom, a fit can match its own points exactly while being catastrophically wrong.
Correspondences are clustered: 0.463 of the overlap has no nearby constraint, so the alignment is extrapolated there even if it is accurate where the points are.

evidence.name: n_inliers
evidence.statement: Only 3 inliers (rule: reject at <= 8). Validated at recall 1.000 on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002).

evidence.name: loop_error_px
evidence.statement: Not evaluated -- needs a third overlapping image. This is the only estimator shown to catch a coherent wrong solution, so the verdict is weaker than it could be.

evidence.name: coverage_max_gap
evidence.statement: Largest unconstrained region is 0.463 of the image (target <= 0.15). The transform is extrapolating where there are no correspondences.

evidence.name: inlier_ratio
evidence.statement: 3/35 putative matches survived geometric verification. Self-consistency only: misses 8.7% of failures (EXP-002).

evidence.name: fit_rmse
evidence.statement: Reported for transparency and EXCLUDED from the verdict. ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.

excluded.fit_rmse: ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.
excluded.held_out_residual: Detection 0.200 against coherent wrong solutions (EXP-002 objective 4, ADR-0011). A match set 64 px wrong yielded 0.468 px -- lower than a correct-but-noisy set at 1.424 px. Degeneracy detector only.
excluded.cycle_consistency: Blind to symmetric errors by construction (E-012): forward +64 px and backward -64 px cancel exactly, scoring 0.000 on wrong cases against 0.325 on the correct one -- an inverted signal.
